updates.title: Copilot for JetBrains adds managed model defaults and MCP startup controls
updates.whatChanged: GitHub added enterprise-managed settings to choose the default Copilot agent model for new JetBrains conversations, while preserving the user's ability to choose another model. A new setting can also disable automatic startup of configured MCP servers for Copilot and Claude.
updates.whyCare: Administrators can set a more consistent model starting point and developers can reduce when configured tools become active. These controls improve IDE-level operations, but do not amount to model allowlisting or authorization for MCP tools.
updates.before: JetBrains users chose among exposed models without the newly announced managed default-model setting, and configured MCP servers started automatically.
updates.after: Administrators can set the default agent model for new conversations, and users can disable automatic MCP server startup; explicit model selection remains available.
updates.learn: Treat a managed default as a starting preference, not an enforced model policy. Validate its scope alongside model allowlists or gateway routing, and keep MCP authorization and least-privilege controls independent of whether servers start automatically.

sources.name: GitHub Changelog - New controls and chat improvements in Copilot for JetBrains

updates.architectureImplication: Compare the managed default with stricter enterprise model-policy or gateway-based routing when model selection must be constrained. Treat the MCP startup toggle as a client activation control, not as a replacement for server permissions, scoped credentials, or auditing.
